definitions.ask: How should a one-placeholder row keep a `URL %` listen marker on its URL now that rows split on spaces?

choices.label: Quote `"URL %"` or put `%` in the template; every row shares one lexer
A lone `%` or `@` after a value joins it, so `URL %` rows work unquoted; adds a lexer rule

definitions.why: One lexer for every row is easier to predict; `{0} %` covers the all-listen case

definitions.ask: Should the Bulk Capture glossary say a `{0}`-only template takes one capture per value?
definitions.corrects: Template rows are later nonblank physical lines, one capture per line, not blank-line-separated items
